items.title: Immunology specialist Khartis Therapeutics emerges from stealth with $95m
items.summary: Khartis was co-founded two years ago by the team at XinThera, a biotech acquired by Gilead.

items.title: BMS secures FDA accelerated approval for Zenbexus in multiple myeloma
items.summary: The FDA has granted accelerated approval to BMS' Zenbexus, along with daratumumab and hyaluronidase-fihj and dexamethasone (ZDd), to treat adult multiple myeloma.

items.title: Xanadu and University of Alberta to develop quantum algorithms for cancer
items.summary: Xanadu Quantum Technologies and the University of Alberta in Canada partnered to advance algorithms to treat cancer.

items.title: Repligen’s deal for BioLife Solutions indicates shift to manufacturing integration
items.summary: Repligen’s $1.5bn purchase of BioLife Solutions adds CryoStor biopreservation to its bioprocessing portfolio, underscoring pharma’s shift toward integrated cell and gene therapy supply chains.

items.title: United global response to US childhood vaccine overhaul
items.summary: Recommended changes to the US immunisation schedule by President Trump have been met with widespread retaliation.
